name: panelpon4
author: CanyonTurtle
description: A Panel de Pon-style block matching game: swap panels to line up matching colors as the stack keeps rising. Press X to start.

descriptions.en: A Panel de Pon-style block matching game: swap panels to line up matching colors as the stack keeps rising. Press X to start.
descriptions.it: Un puzzle a blocchi in stile Panel de Pon: scambia i pannelli per allineare i colori uguali mentre la pila continua a salire. Premi X per iniziare.
